# Generated by vickers_build.py (shared Commonwealth Vickers). Edit the generator, not this file.
on_actions = {
	# new games only (on_startup doesn't run when loading a save): turns the shared Commonwealth Vickers on
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			set_global_flag = vickers_shared_bloc
		}
	}
	# ROOT = the MIO that grew
	on_mio_size_increased = {
		effect = {
			# a size-up from a copied trait: use up one pending count, pay nothing
			if = {
				limit = { has_mio_flag = { flag = vickers_copy_pending value > 0 } }
				modify_mio_flag = { flag = vickers_copy_pending value = -1 }
			}
			# a size-up from the partner's own production or research: pay the UK
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_mio_flag = vickers_partner_copy
					country_exists = ENG
					ENG = { has_capitulated = no }
				}
				ENG_vickers_contribute = yes
			}
		}
	}
	# keep the bloc up to date: partners that joined late catch up, partners that left stop contributing
	on_monthly_ENG = {
		effect = {
			every_country = {
				limit = { OR = { original_tag = CAN original_tag = AST original_tag = NZL original_tag = SAF original_tag = RAJ } }
				if = {
					limit = { ENG_vickers_follows_uk = yes }
					ENG_vickers_sync_partner = yes
					ENG_vickers_pay_uk = yes
				}
				else = {
					mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { clr_mio_flag = vickers_partner_copy }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
